message: Last winter, we had a snowstorm that had us all hunkering down. I decided to turn it into a cozy event instead of a cold nightmare. I piled up blankets, brewed some hot cocoa, and put on the most ridiculous holiday movie I could find. My grandkids thought we were having a snow day party! It reminded me that sometimes, a little planning and a warm drink can make even the worst weather feel like a fun adventure. Do you have a favorite cozy storm memory? ☕
